splits.rule: stratified by area; no #1188 screen case in held-out; .agro/hooks train-only (plan decision 11)

noise_screen.reason: the pass-rate guard needs 36 attempts per arm: one extra failure is 0.028, inside the 0.05 tolerance

efficiency_score.hard: 1 when the episode passes verify-prd.sh and costs 0.80 or less of the baseline-train median cost of the case

decision.metric: per-case ratio r_i = mean candidate cost / mean baseline cost over the held-out repeats
decision.interval: 95% percentile bootstrap of the aggregate over cases

amendments.change: verifier fix #1210: a new-word declares new only its object spans (the first span after the word and each span that a comma, and, or, plus, or / joins to it; a span before (new); the first cell of a table row with a new-word in a later cell; a parent directory of a declared-new path on a new-word line). A path after no path under, touches no, does not touch, do not touch, or never touches in the same sentence is declared absent. Each file under .agro/tasks/<name>/ other than prd.md, prd.json, and AGENTS.md, outside archive/, is declared new unless it is declared absent or .agro/tasks/archive/*/<name>/ exists at the revision. verify_prd_sh was 2724c466131215993dd45fcde1e8a6f347f1410968cd01ec752c757cb5addddd. Stored results keep their recorded verdicts; the rescore list is in the PR body.

verifier fix #1219: a path after retire, retires, or retired in the same sentence is declared absent, and a path after no and before exist or exists in the same sentence is declared absent (for example "No `.pi/skills` link exists"). verify_prd_sh was 18ac79ad951eee8f7f2df942837b378cad126c5b544c93a51d6ea8c808811d11. Stored results keep their recorded verdicts; heldout-1211 is rescored in runs/heldout-1211/summary.rescore-1219.json of prd-efficiency, and the rescore list is in the PR body.

runner arms #1228: --arm-effort <arm>=low|medium|high replaces the --effort value of claude_args for that arm, and the episode line records it as effort. --arm-rev baseline=<rev> replaces the baseline SKILL.md with the file at <rev>; without it, the baseline arm keeps the base_revision tree. Pinned values do not change. Episodes without these options run as before.
